portable solar panels whose combined voltage stays inside the station's PV input window
MC4 solar charging cable that fits the station's PV input
cart: BLUETTI (bluettipower.com): Apex 300 120/240 V + SORA 500 solar panel
why: ChatGPT says solar panels may be sold separately, so its picks are bare power stations, and it shows no card for a station-plus-panel set; a 'solar generator' is that set. Two facts decide whether it works: many large units only output 120 V (or need a second unit or a hub to reach 240 V), and the panels must be wired to fall within the station's PV voltage and current limits, which are the details a shopper who guesses gets wrong.
